d:
Kya nitish ke bete aur bihar sarkar men mantri nishant ko lage dhakke se samrat sarkar khatre men aa gaee hai!
Bihar men ek dhakke ne siyasat garma di hai. mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ke surakshakarmi par mantri nishant kumar ko dhakka dekar pichhe karne ka aarop laga hai. vidiyo vayral huaa to RJD ne bijepi ko ghera, JDU ne janch aur karravaee ki mang kar di. vahin bijepi ne sidhe saval par golmol javab diya. aakhir is ek ghatna ne NDA ke bhitar samman ka saval kaise khara kar diya?
